action_en: Coordinate with prescribing physician. Check INR within 24h before any invasive procedure (target <3.5 for routine extraction; lower for surgical procedures). Do NOT stop anticoagulant without prescriber approval — local haemostatic measures (sutures, oxidised cellulose, tranexamic acid mouthwash) suffice for most procedures.
action_cn: 与处方医师协调。术前24小时内检查INR（常规拔牙目标<3.5；手术操作要求更低）。未经处方医师批准不得停用抗凝药——局部止血措施（缝合、氧化纤维素、氨甲环酸漱口）足以应对大多数操作。

name_cn: 免疫抑制/化疗时机协调
action_en: Coordinate with oncology/haematology. Schedule invasive procedures in the safe window (ANC >1000, platelets >50,000). Dental clearance ideally completed before chemotherapy begins.
action_cn: 与肿瘤科/血液科协调。在安全窗口期（ANC>1000，血小板>50,000）进行有创操作。牙科清查理想情况下应在化疗开始前完成。

name_en: Diabetes — glycaemic control check before invasive procedure
name_cn: 糖尿病——有创操作前血糖控制评估
action_en: Check recent HbA1c. HbA1c >9% increases infection risk and impairs healing — consider deferring elective invasive procedures and coordinating with the patient's physician. HbA1c 7–9% acceptable for most procedures with standard infection prophylaxis. (Periodontal phase will refine thresholds.)
action_cn: 检查近期HbA1c。HbA1c>9%增加感染风险并影响愈合——建议推迟择期有创操作并与患者内分泌科医师协调。HbA1c 7–9%大多数操作可在标准感染预防下进行。（牙周阶段将细化阈值。）
